{{Top|leg}}
A '''blutfish''' was an aquatic creature native to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. It was known to be ravenous.

==Behind the scenes==
The blutfish was referenced in the profile for the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Deep Hunter]] in ''[[Death in the Undercity]]''. When the adventure was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'', the reference to the blutfish was removed.

==Appearances==
*''[[Death in the Undercity]]'' {{Reprint|Death in the Undercity}}
